description: This repository contains the code used by Szell and collaborators to study the growth of urban bicycle networks. It prepares OpenStreetMap networks and points of interest, simulates alternative expansion sequences and saves network metrics, plots and videos. Inputs define cities, railway-station or grid seed points and betweenness, closeness or random pruning choices; outputs compare the resulting network-growth scenarios. Coverage is city-specific, with growth steps representing infrastructure additions, not a fixed calendar period. Source is free under AGPL-3.0, with local notebook and SLURM instructions. A limitation is that the authors describe this as research code, with substantial outputs and manual preparation for large cities; a more user-friendly successor is being developed separately. The model can assess active-mobility infrastructure expansion and connectivity. OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap) is its stated input source. The repository links the Scientific Reports paper and archived study data. No network files were downloaded.
